servers.description: List of NTP servers to query for time. Each entry must specify a hostname or IP address; optional port (default 123).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server.

port.description: UDP port of the NTP server (standard NTP port is 123).

key_id.description: Optional key ID to use for authenticated NTP queries (requires trusted_keys and keys_file).

interface.description: Network interface to bind to for outgoing NTP queries (empty string = bind to all interfaces).

logging.description: Logging verbosity and optional log file path.

logfile.description: Path to write log file (e.g., '/var/log/sntp.log'). Leave empty to log to syslog only.

offset_limit.description: Maximum initial time offset (seconds) to accept before syncing. If the offset exceeds this, sync fails.

max_samples.description: Maximum number of samples (packets) to exchange per server.

strict.description: Enable strict mode: reject servers whose reported offset changes drastically between polls.

leap_smear.description: Enable leap second smearing (gradually adjust time during leap events instead of step change).

trusted_keys.description: List of key IDs considered trusted for authentication (e.g., [1, 2]). Must match entries in keys file.

request_key_id.description: Key ID used for the request packet (e.g., for symmetric key auth). Requires 'trusted_keys' and 'keys_file'.

keys_file.description: Path to the file containing symmetric keys (format: keyid MD5 secret). Only needed for authenticated NTP.

timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) per server before trying next server.

poll_interval.description: Polling interval (seconds) for periodic background syncs (0 disables periodic sync).

burst.description: Enable burst mode: send multiple packets on first contact to reduce latency and improve accuracy.

initial_delay.description: Delay (seconds) before first synchronization attempt after startup (useful to wait for network).
